# Economic System Rework: World Economic League display (generated by league_gui.py)

# Opens the window (country scope, ROOT = the player).
won_lg_open = {
	clr_country_flag = won_show_dash
	clr_country_flag = won_show_race
	clr_country_flag = won_show_sphere
	set_country_flag = won_show_league
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = won_lg_tab } }
		set_variable = { won_lg_tab = 1 }
	}
	# Opened before our first monthly ranking: calculate it now
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rank_gdp < 1 } }
		won_world_rank = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_lg_h11 < 0.001 } }
		won_lg_monthly = yes
	}
	won_lg_show = yes
}

# Monthly, human players: share-of-world history, and a refresh if the window is open.
won_lg_monthly = {
	set_variable = { won_lg_h0 = won_lg_h1 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h1 = won_lg_h2 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h2 = won_lg_h3 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h3 = won_lg_h4 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h4 = won_lg_h5 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h5 = won_lg_h6 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h6 = won_lg_h7 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h7 = won_lg_h8 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h8 = won_lg_h9 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h9 = won_lg_h10 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h10 = won_lg_h11 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_h11 = won_gdp_share }
	set_temp_variable = { won_hm = 0.1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h0 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h1 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h2 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h3 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h4 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h5 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h6 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h6 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h7 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h7 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h8 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h9 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h9 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h10 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_lg_h11 value = won_hm compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_hm = won_lg_h11 } }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hmax = won_hm }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf0 = won_lg_h0 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf0 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf0 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf0 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf0
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf0 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf1 = won_lg_h1 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf1 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf1 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf1 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf1
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf1 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf2 = won_lg_h2 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf2 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf2 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf2 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf2
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf2 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf3 = won_lg_h3 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf3 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf3 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf3 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf3
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf3 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf4 = won_lg_h4 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf4 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf4 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf4 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf4
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf4 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf5 = won_lg_h5 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf5 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf5 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf5 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf5
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf5 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf6 = won_lg_h6 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf6 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf6 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf6 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf6
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf6 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf7 = won_lg_h7 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf7 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf7 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf7 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf7
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf7 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf8 = won_lg_h8 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf8 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf8 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf8 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf8
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf8 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf9 = won_lg_h9 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf9 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf9 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf9 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf9
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf9 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf10 = won_lg_h10 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf10 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf10 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf10 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf10
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf10 min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_variable = { won_lg_hf11 = won_lg_h11 }
	divide_variable = { won_lg_hf11 = won_hm }
	multiply_variable = { won_lg_hf11 = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { won_lg_hf11 = 1 }
	round_variable = won_lg_hf11
	clamp_variable = { var = won_lg_hf11 min = 1 max = 21 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_show_league }
		won_lg_show = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_show_race }
		won_race_show = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_show_sphere }
		won_sphere_show = yes
	}
}

# Copies the selected table into the display variables.
won_lg_show = {
	set_variable = { won_lg_n = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_lg_tab = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v0 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_lg_c0 = global.won_rk_gdp_c0 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_v0 = global.won_rk_gdp_v0 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_d0 = global.won_rk_gdp_d0 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v1 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_lg_c1 = global.won_rk_gdp_c1 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_v1 = global.won_rk_gdp_v1 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_d1 = global.won_rk_gdp_d1 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v2 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_lg_c2 = global.won_rk_gdp_c2 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_v2 = global.won_rk_gdp_v2 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_d2 = global.won_rk_gdp_d2 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v3 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_lg_c3 = global.won_rk_gdp_c3 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_v3 = global.won_rk_gdp_v3 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_d3 = global.won_rk_gdp_d3 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v4 > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_lg_c4 = global.won_rk_gdp_c4 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_v4 = global.won_rk_gdp_v4 }
			set_variable = { won_lg_d4 = global.won_rk_gdp_d4 }

		}

			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v7 > 0 } }

			set_variable = { won_lg_d7 = global.won_rk_gdp_d7 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		if = {

			set_variable = { won_lg_c8 = global.won_rk_gdp_c8 }

			set_variable = { won_lg_d8 = global.won_rk_gdp_d8 }

			set_variable = { won_lg_d9 = global.won_rk_gdp_d9 }
			add_to_variable = { won_lg_n = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { won_lg_my_v = won_gdp }
		set_variable = { won_lg_my_rank = won_rank_gdp }
	}
	if = {
